## What were you trying to do?

For example: understand the purpose, run the offline demo, inspect a candidate, import an export, or configure Codex.

## Where did you get stuck?

Name the document and section. Include the command with private paths replaced, when relevant.

## What would have helped?

Describe the missing explanation, expected output, or navigation link. Please use invented examples; do not attach private conversation screenshots or exports.
